## TRA Timeline

#### Caritas spin-off announcement and form-of TRA

- 2021-09-29: Amicus and ARYA Sciences Acquisition Corp IV sign Business Combination Agreement; form-of TRA embedded as Annex C to BCA (Exhibit 10.1 to 8-K Item 1.01)

#### Business Combination Agreement termination

- 2022-02-24: BCA mutually terminated (disclosed in FY2021 10-K filed same day); no TRA ever executed

## Explanation

Amicus Therapeutics is associated with a Tax Receivable Agreement only through a planned-but-abandoned SPAC business combination: on September 29, 2021 Amicus and ARYA Sciences Acquisition Corp IV signed a Business Combination Agreement under which ARYA would have domesticated and renamed itself Caritas Therapeutics, Inc., becoming the Up-C PubCo above a gene-therapy operating LLC, with Amicus GT Holdings as a principal TRA Party entitled to 85% of the cash tax savings Caritas would realize from Section 754 basis step-ups on future LLC-unit exchanges. The form-of TRA was attached as Annex C to the BCA (preamble blank, no signatures). The BCA was mutually terminated on February 24, 2022 before any closing, so no party ever signed the TRA and no obligation arose; Amicus's subsequent April 27, 2026 acquisition by BioMarin Pharmaceutical has no TRA implications because no TRA was ever in force. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
